verses.1: Mashá Nino’eh is a book about the visions of the Holy One.
verses.2: May Jehovah heal and remedy them. May Jehovah heal and remedy them. May Jehovah heal the ones who are sick in heart, and may He destroy those who are their enemies.
verses.3: Yehovah will extend His wings and increase His strength. He will not be cleansed by any means; Yehovah will not be cleansed through tears or suffering. His path will be clear, and clouds will not cover His feet.
verses.4: The waves rushed over the sea, and all the rivers were destroyed. The forests and orchards were destroyed by the storm. All the flowers and plants were destroyed as well.
verses.5: The mountains became silent because of us, and the valleys were filled with noise. The earth shook from beneath our feet. Egypt and all its inhabitants were destroyed.
verses.6: Before his anger, who will stand up and who will rise in his place? His anger is like fire, and the Egyptians were destroyed by it.
verses.7: May the Lord be good to those who are in need on difficult days, and may He know their needs.
verses.8: And in the midst of all this chaos, he will still find a place for himself, and his enemies will be defeated.
verses.9: What kind of thoughts do they have about Jehovah? They act in ways that never lead to anything good.
verses.10: For those who are still alive, and those who have died, they are all eaten as food.
verses.11: From you came a thought of evil against Jehovah; it was a warning, but not a real one.
verses.12: Thus said Jehovah: “If they are many, and if they are powerful, and if they are arrogant, then I will not answer your prayers anymore.”
verses.13: And now, I will remove them from above you and from your possessions. I will take them away.
verses.14: And the LORD has commanded you not to plant any crops from your heaven again. No plants or seeds shall be planted there; I will cover your tomb with them, because they are worthless.
